title: Four coordinate groups in 128- and 80-bit cyclic components

claims.statement: For the explicit product of 15 dimension-64 length-128 blocks and one dimension-40 length-80 block, with the six-scan four-group decoder in proof.md, uniform-message average block error is at most 497469774115392249/500000000000000000 on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses carrying 1000 bits.
The bsc-ops-v1 program in proof.md for the same explicit product and six-scan decoder executes exactly W=92104426581 operations on every received word, with W <= 2^(36423/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check all information sets and automorphism generators, enumerate the reduced distance searches and weight-20 orbit, then derive the exact spectra and collision certificate and check the error, memory and operation claims.
